name: Legend of the Moon: Those Who Crossed
detailed_description:
Legend of the Moon: Those Who Crossed is a sci-fi action RPG set in a devastated world where Earth and the Moon are at war.

Take on the role of a warrior who defies fate and explores a ruined future through combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving as you uncover hidden truths.

• DYNAMIC REAL-TIME COMBAT

Engage in responsive melee combat, precise dodging, and well-timed attacks to defeat waves of enemies.

Swap weapons to change your fighting style—launch homing missiles, explosive bombs, or rapid-fire energy projectiles based on your strategy.

• ELEMENTAL WEAPON SYSTEM

Each weapon has unique elemental properties, allowing for diverse playstyles and tactical flexibility.

Your weapon choices affect not just battles, but also how you approach dungeon structures and enemy types.

• CHARACTER GROWTH & PUZZLE INTEGRATION

As the story progresses, your character levels up and gains new skills that enhance both combat and exploration.

Some skills unlock new paths or help solve light environmental puzzles.

Puzzles are thoughtfully designed to offer breathing room between intense battles, avoiding repetition or frustration.

• A WORLD IN FLUX

Explore vast, interconnected fields shaped by war.

Travel between Earth and the Moon, discovering hidden areas and environmental changes that shift the course of your journey.

• ACCESSIBLE EVEN IF YOU’RE NEW TO THE SERIES

Though this is the third entry in the Legend of the Moon series, it features a standalone structure that requires no prior knowledge of the previous games.

New players can jump in and fully enjoy the experience without playing the earlier titles.

Legend of the Moon: Those Who Crossed delivers cinematic atmosphere, impactful combat, meaningful exploration,

and a mystery-driven narrative set in a world teetering on the edge of collapse.

Your choices in this ruined world may change everything.
